fullPassage: Manufacturers masterfully sow seeds of doubt about the adequacy of our current devices. Suddenly, the phone that was your lifeline a year ago is now a museum piece, unable to keep pace with your digital demands. And thus, the itch to upgrade begins, often before there's a genuine need. This cycle isn't just confined to our digital companions. It spills over into almost every aspect of consumer electronics, from the self-driving car to the smart fridge. Every product seems to be on an unstoppable march towards the next version, the next generation that promises to revolutionize your life. What's fascinating, or perhaps disturbing, is the utter efficacy of this cycle in shaping our desires. It's not so much that we want the newest device; we're led to believe we need it. The distinction between want and need blurs, shifting our financial priorities in favor of staying current with trends. For all the logical arguments against this ceaseless upgrading, the temptation remains compelling.

questions.passage:
(A) The company tried to shift its marketing strategy to attract younger consumers.
(B) The nurse worked the night shift at the hospital every weekend.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 shift의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 회사가 마케팅 전략을 젊은 소비자를 끌기 위해 '전환하려' 했다 / (B) 간호사가 매주 주말 병원에서 야간 '교대 근무'를 했다
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 전환하다 — (B) 교대 근무 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 교대 근무 — (B) 전환하다 (의미 뒤바뀜)
❌ ③ (A) 옮기다 — (B) 교대 근무 (A는 전략을 '전환'하다가 더 정확)
❌ ④ (A) 전환하다 — (B) 변속기 (B는 night shift = 야간 교대 근무)
det.tip: shift: (방향/전략을) 전환하다 vs (교대) 근무. 본문의 shifting our financial priorities = 재정 우선순위를 전환하는

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"the quality of being good enough or suitable for a particular purpose"

det.korean: 특정 목적에 충분히 좋거나 적합한 성질 → adequacy(적절함)
det.analysis:
❌ ① efficacy — 효능 (결과의 효과성이지 적합성 아님)
❌ ② temptation — 유혹 (무관)
❌ ③ distinction — 구분, 차이 (무관)
✅ ④ adequacy — 적절함, 충분함 ←정답
det.tip: adequacy = 적절함, 충분함. the adequacy of = ~의 적절성

questions.passage: What's __________ (fascinate), or perhaps disturbing, is the utter efficacy of this cycle in shaping our desires.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: '흥미로운' 것, 혹은 불안한 것은 이 순환의 완전한 효능이다 → 형용사 fascinating
det.analysis: __________ (fascinate) → 보어 자리(What's ___). fascinate(동사) → fascinating(형용사)으로 변환. 감정 유발 대상(순환의 효능)이 주어이므로 -ing형.
det.tip: fascinate(매혹하다) → fascinating(매혹적인, 흥미로운). 사물 주어 → -ing 형용사

questions.passage: Manufacturers __________ (master) sow seeds of doubt about the adequacy of our current devices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 제조업체들이 '능숙하게' 의구심의 씨앗을 뿌린다 → 부사 masterfully
det.analysis: __________ sow → 동사(sow)를 수식하는 부사 자리. master(명사/동사) → masterful(형용사) → masterfully(부사)로 변환.
det.tip: master(숙달하다) → masterful(능숙한) → masterfully(능숙하게)

questions.passage: Manufacturers masterfully sow seeds of doubt about the adequacy of our current devices. Suddenly, the phone that was your lifeline a year ago is now a museum piece, unable to keep pace with your digital demands. And thus, the itch to upgrade begins, often before there's a genuine need. This cycle isn't just confined to our digital companions. It spills over into almost every aspect of consumer electronics, from the self-driving car to the smart fridge. Every product seems to be on an unstoppable march towards the next version, the next generation that promises to revolutionize your life. What's fascinating, or perhaps disturbing, is the utter efficacy of this cycle in shaping our desires. It's not so much that we want the newest device; we're led to believe we need it. The distinction between want and need blurs, shifting our financial priorities __________ staying current with trends. For all the logical arguments against this ceaseless upgrading, the temptation remains compelling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 트렌드를 따라가는 것에 '유리하게' 재정 우선순위를 변화시킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① regardless of — ~에 상관없이 (shifting priorities와 논리 불일치)
❌ ② instead of — ~대신에 (priorities를 shifting하는 것과 어색)
✅ ③ in favor of — ~에 유리하게. shifting our financial priorities ___ staying current ←정답
❌ ④ in spite of — ~에도 불구하고 (shifting과 논리 불일치)
det.tip: in favor of = ~에 유리하게, ~을 선호하여. shift priorities in favor of = ~을 위해 우선순위를 바꾸다

questions.passage: Manufacturers masterfully sow seeds of doubt about the adequacy of our current devices. Suddenly, the phone that was your lifeline a year ago is now a museum piece, unable to keep pace with your digital demands. And thus, the itch to upgrade begins, often before there's a genuine need. This cycle isn't just confined to our digital companions. It spills over into almost every aspect of consumer electronics, from the self-driving car to the smart fridge. Every product seems to be on an unstoppable march towards the next version, the next generation that promises to revolutionize your life. What's fascinating, or perhaps disturbing, is the utter efficacy of this cycle in shaping our desires. It's not so much that we want the newest device; we're led to believe we need it. The distinction between want and need blurs, shifting our financial priorities in favor of __________. For all the logical arguments against this ceaseless upgrading, the temptation remains compelling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 원함과 필요의 구분이 흐려지면서 '트렌드를 따라가는 것'에 유리하게 재정 우선순위가 바뀐다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① sowing seeds of doubt about devices — 기기에 대한 의구심의 씨앗을 뿌리는 것 (제조업체 행위이지 소비자 재정 우선순위가 아님)
❌ ② keeping pace with digital demands — 디지털 요구에 맞추는 것 (앞 문장 내용으로, in favor of와 어색)
❌ ③ believing we need the newest device — 최신 기기가 필요하다고 믿는 것 (앞 문장 내용이며 in favor of와 부적합)
✅ ④ staying current with trends — 트렌드를 따라가는 것. in favor of ___ ←정답
det.tip: staying current with trends = 트렌드에 최신 상태를 유지하다. current = 최신의, 현재의

ch: sowing seeds of doubt about devices
believing we need the newest device
